summary.what_broke: The checkout API stopped serving requests after revision 42 of its task definition was deployed.
summary.impact: Customers cannot pay: the load balancer has no healthy targets and answers with 5xx since 10:41.
summary.scope: Only checkout-api in prod is affected; the database instance checkout-prod-db is available.

symptoms: The health check of checkout.example.com fails
The load balancer answers with 5xx and has no healthy targets

causes.label: confirmed
causes.statement: Revision checkout-api:42, deployed at 10:37, changed the environment variable DB_HOST to checkout-db.internal.example.com, which does not resolve, so every new task exits with code 1 and fails its health check

causes.label: candidate
causes.statement: A load spike on the database or its backup made the database unreachable

hypotheses.statement: The new task definition points the application at a host that does not resolve
hypotheses.prediction: New tasks log a name resolution error and exit
hypotheses.test: Compare revisions 41 and 42 and read the application logs

hypotheses.statement: A database load spike or backup caused the outage
hypotheses.prediction: Impact starts when the database is busy
hypotheses.test: Compare the database metrics and events with the impact start

actions.label: recommended
actions.title: Roll checkout-api back to task definition revision 41
actions.current_state: The service runs revision 42 with DB_HOST set to checkout-db.internal.example.com
actions.required_state: The service runs revision 41, whose DB_HOST names the database endpoint
actions.change: Update the service checkout/checkout-api to task definition checkout-api:41
actions.rationale: Revision 41 differs only in DB_HOST and ran without errors before the deployment
actions.risk: Anything that shipped only in revision 42 is undone; the images are the same
verification: The health check of checkout.example.com passes
rollback: Update the service to task definition checkout-api:42 again

actions.label: candidate
actions.title: Check that DB_HOST resolves before a task definition is deployed
actions.current_state: A task definition with an unresolvable DB_HOST can be deployed
actions.required_state: The deployment pipeline refuses a revision whose DB_HOST does not resolve
actions.change: Add a name resolution check of DB_HOST to the deployment pipeline
actions.rationale: The failure was visible in the configuration before any task started
verification: A test deployment with a wrong DB_HOST is refused
rollback: Remove the check from the pipeline

open_questions: Who intended the change to DB_HOST, and where does checkout-db.internal.example.com come from?

not_checked.why: The service runs on ECS and no cluster is mapped
